neighbours.label: server storage and connection infrastructure (storage arrays, file servers, non-blocking connections, SAN clusters)
fire: The cluster keeps its virtual machine images on a shared storage volume over iSCSI.
We replaced the aging NAS with a faster storage array for the database servers.
The worker uses non-blocking I/O so one slow connection cannot stall the queue.
Old log files are moved off the file server onto tape every month.
Each node in the failover cluster mounts the same disks from the SAN.
The backup job copies snapshots from primary storage to a remote replica.
Connection pooling keeps the database from opening a new socket for every request.
The admins added two more shelves of disks to the storage controller.
quiet: The cluster of houses keeps its rainwater in a shared tank behind the barn.
We replaced the aging sofa with a softer couch for the living room.
The waiter uses a small notebook so no order gets lost during the rush.
Old letters are moved from the attic into boxes every spring.
Each member of the choir sings the same notes from the printed score.
The photographer copies prints from the album to give to relatives.
Carpooling keeps the office from needing a parking space for every worker.
The librarians added two more shelves of books to the reading room.
